productionBoundary: A dedicated Firebase / Google Cloud project used by DSBC alone (own Auth pool, Firestore database dsbc-production in Standard edition, default Storage bucket, Hosting site, Cloud Functions identity, Secret Manager, IAM, quotas and logs).

reasons: AUTH: one project-wide Firebase Auth pool (FIREBASE_AUTH, no multi-tenancy); only Google sign-in enabled while DSBC needs email/password; enabling it changes sign-up for every app in the project
IAM: the default compute service account holds roles/editor on the project and is Vidwan Kids' Cloud Run identity; Cloud Functions gen 2 use it by default
STORAGE: the registry bucket v-nexus-lite.firebasestorage.app does not exist (404), the Cloud Storage for Firebase API is disabled, and the DSBC backend writes to the project's default bucket
WEB_APP: DSBC's web configuration is the generic ai-studio-applet-webapp shared with AI Studio applets
CO_TENANTS: V-Nexus Lite (default site, (default) database), Vidwan Kids (site, Cloud Run, bucket) and two other AI Studio applet databases share the project
already hosts another application ("My Google AI Studio App") with its own (default) database
the operator account has no permission to inspect it; its purpose must be stated by the owner before it can be considered

proposedRegion: asia-south1 (owner to confirm; Firestore location is permanent)
enforcement: config/environments.json production.boundary.dedicatedProject=false -> preflight PRODUCTION_BOUNDARY = BLOCKED (ENV-020, mutant E16); unfilled <PLACEHOLDER> values refused by the resolver (ENV-022, mutant E17)
criticalBlockers: C1 v-nexus-lite cannot isolate DSBC (Auth, IAM/runtime identity, Storage)
C2 no dedicated DSBC project exists that the operator can use
C3 no App Owner identity designated
C4 DSBC has no email-verification flow; the App Owner claim requires a verified email
C5 no public domain chosen for canonical / QR URLs
C6 RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET / RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET must exist before functions can deploy
humanActionsRequired: H1 create the dedicated DSBC Firebase project and link Blaze billing (or state that dsbc-e8ok3g3sf is intended and grant access)
H2 approve the API list and the region (asia-south1 proposed)
H3 choose the public domain and add DNS records
H4 name the App Owner email
H5 set the two Razorpay secrets (placeholders while payments are disabled)
H6 enable Email/Password and initialize Storage in the Console
H7 decide on a notifications provider or accept NOT_CONFIGURED
H8 approve each live deployment step
H9 recruit the three pilot customers
